title: WM Keyboard addon repository manifest
description: Schema for wmkeyboard-repo.json, the root index of a WM Keyboard addon repository.

format.description: Magic tag. Must be exactly "wmkeyboard-repo"; the client rejects anything else.

id.description: Stable repository id (reverse-DNS recommended, e.g. com.example.coolpack). Used to namespace installed addons.

icon.description: Repository icon: a path relative to this manifest, or an absolute https URL.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the repo was last updated.

id.description: Addon id, unique within this repository.

type.description: Addon kind. Determines which native import path installs it.

version.description: Semver version string. Drives update detection.

path.description: Payload location: a path relative to this manifest's directory, or an absolute https URL (hybrid model).

sha256.description: Optional lowercase hex SHA-256 of the payload file. Verified before install when present; an addon without one installs normally and is shown as unverified.

sizeBytes.description: Optional payload size, used for the UI and a pre-download guard. The client caps every download regardless.

previews.description: Optional screenshot/preview images (relative paths or absolute https URLs).

minAppVersion.description: Optional minimum app versionCode required to install.

langId.description: Language id from the app's LanguageRegistry. REQUIRED for type=dictionary; optional grouping hint for type=layout. Must be an already-registered id.

langIds.description: Languages this addon covers, when one id is not enough. Mainly for fonts: a face that declares its languages is only offered in the pickers for those scripts, so a Latin-only display font is not offered for Bengali. Omit to make no claim, which offers it everywhere.

license.description: Licence identifier — an SPDX id where one fits (MIT, OFL-1.1, CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0), otherwise any short name. Shown on the addon's page.

licenseText.description: Full licence text inline. Use for a licence with no identifier worth quoting; prefer licenseFile for anything long.

licenseFile.description: Licence text as a file: a path relative to this manifest, or an absolute https URL. Fetched on demand when the user opens the licence.
